observations.explanation: Page 4 describes observations using URL, open tabs, and focused-page content, with configurable HTML/DOM, screenshot, and accessibility-tree representations, plus multi-tab functionality.
Pages 7–8 describe natural-language intents with programmatic outcome checks and report that each information-seeking question was annotated twice, with a third annotator resolving disagreements.

Page 9 reports low end-to-end success rates for the tested baselines (7.14%, 7.38%, and 10.59% in the table; the prose also reports 10.63% for GPT-4), supporting the claim that these agents often fail on the benchmark.

Page 9 specifies text-input/text-action GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 baselines and a 30-transition limit. The observation appropriately limits its inference: this comparison does not establish a benchmark ceiling or general agent performance.
